label: 3. Did you get home safe yesterday?

lines.text: Did you get home safe yesterday?

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: Oh,

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: right...

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: It should be today, not yesterday.
Can you explain that?

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: You're teasing me...

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: because you want to reminisce about the time you spent with me, right?

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: Then I'll leave a message to remind you what happened yesterday.

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: You remember now?

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: Ah... you were pretending not to, weren't you?
You catch on fast!
I had such a great time yesterday!

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: Well, it's about you, after all...

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: I maybe gloomy and dark,

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: but I can handle jokes like this...

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: Heh... heheheh...

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: I really enjoyed it too.

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: It's the kind of date I've always dreamed about.
If it's a date like yesterday, I'd be down for it again.

lines.speaker: label

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: you seem to know me pretty well too...

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: I want to go on another date with you too...

lines.text: So... shall we meet again tomorrow?
No, I don't mean that literally...
I'm just saying...

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: On our date tomorrow,

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: I want to do even the things we couldn't do yesterday...

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: Heh heh heh...

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: Eating is important.

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: After all, it's one of the three basic human desires.

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: But once your appetite is satisfied,

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: other desires will raise their heads.
We're really just going to eat.

lines.text: Hehehehehehe...

Maybe... it's time I back away...
At-home dates sound good to me.

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: Aaaaaah...!

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: Is it really okay for me to be this happy?

lines.speaker: label
lines.text: I'm so happy... I'm starting to worry that maybe everything that's happened so far was just my delusion.
